meaning.en: Paippalada, Angiras, and Sanatkumara
meaning.hi: पैप्पलाद, अंगिरा और सनत्कुमार

meaning.en: asked Atharvan
meaning.hi: अथर्वा से पूछा

meaning.en: what meditation is to be taken up first and held onto
meaning.hi: कौन-सा ध्यान पहले अपनाना और थामे रखना है

meaning.en: and what exactly is that meditation
meaning.hi: और वह ध्यान है क्या

meaning.en: who is the meditator
meaning.hi: ध्याता कौन है

meaning.en: what is the object meditated upon
meaning.hi: ध्येय क्या है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: om iti akṣaram etat agre kāryā upāsanā

meaning.en: Om, this syllable, is the meditation to be taken up first
meaning.hi: ॐ, यह अक्षर, पहले अपनाया जाने वाला ध्यान है

meaning.en: this syllable is the highest brahman
meaning.hi: यह अक्षर सबसे ऊँचा ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: it stands on four feet, as the Vedas stand on four
meaning.hi: यह चार पैरों पर खड़ा है, जैसे वेद चार पर खड़े हैं

meaning.en: its first measure is the earth, the sound a
meaning.hi: पहली मात्रा पृथ्वी है, अ की ध्वनि

words.sanskrit: ṛg-vedaḥ ṛcaḥ brahmā vasavaḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ gārhapatyaḥ agniḥ

meaning.en: bound to it: Rigveda, Brahma, the Vasus, Gayatri metre, household fire
meaning.hi: इससे जुड़े: ऋग्वेद, ब्रह्मा, वसुगण, गायत्री छंद, गार्हपत्य अग्नि

meaning.en: the second measure is the mid-air, the sound u
meaning.hi: दूसरी मात्रा अंतरिक्ष है, उ की ध्वनि

words.sanskrit: yajur-vedaḥ yajūṁṣi viṣṇuḥ rudrāḥ triṣṭup dakṣiṇāgniḥ

meaning.en: answering to it: Yajurveda, Vishnu, the Rudras, trishtubh metre, southern fire
meaning.hi: इसके जवाब में: यजुर्वेद, विष्णु, रुद्रगण, त्रिष्टुप्, दक्षिणाग्नि

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the third measure is the sky, the sound m
meaning.hi: तीसरी मात्रा आकाश है, म की ध्वनि

words.sanskrit: sāma-vedaḥ sāmāni rudrāḥ ādityāḥ jagatī chandaḥ āhavanīyaḥ agniḥ

meaning.en: belonging to it: Samaveda, the Rudras, the Adityas, jagati metre, the offering fire
meaning.hi: इसके हिस्से में: सामवेद, रुद्रगण, आदित्यगण, जगती छंद, आहवनीय अग्नि

words.sanskrit: caturthī mātrā ardha-mātrā soma-lokaḥ om iti

meaning.en: the fourth measure, only half a beat, is the world of soma, Om itself
meaning.hi: चौथी मात्रा, आधी मात्रा, सोम-लोक है, ॐ स्वयं

words.sanskrit: atharva-vedaḥ ātharvaṇāḥ mantrāḥ saṁvartako'gniḥ marutaḥ virāḍ chandaḥ ekarṣiḥ

meaning.en: belonging to it: Atharvaveda, the fire that gathers all in at the close, the Maruts, viraj metre, the single seer
meaning.hi: इसके हिस्से में: अथर्ववेद, संवर्तक अग्नि, मरुद्गण, विराट् छंद, अकेला ऋषि

meaning.en: remembered as the one that shines
meaning.hi: प्रकाशमान कहकर स्मरण किया गया

words.sanskrit: prathamā mātrā rohiṇī pītā mahad-brahma devatā

meaning.en: the first measure is red turning to yellow, ruled by the great brahman
meaning.hi: पहली मात्रा लाल है, पीले की ओर, महान् ब्रह्म देवता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the second measure is full of lightning, dark, ruled by Vishnu
meaning.hi: दूसरी मात्रा बिजली से भरी, काली, विष्णु देवता

meaning.en: the third holds fair and foul, white, ruled by Rudra
meaning.hi: तीसरी में भला-बुरा दोनों, सफ़ेद, रुद्र देवता

meaning.en: the fourth is also full of lightning, holds every colour, ruled by the Purusha
meaning.hi: चौथी भी बिजली से भरी, सब रंगों वाली, पुरुष देवता

words.sanskrit: etat om iti catur-akṣaram catuṣ-pāt catur-mūrdhā catur-mātram

meaning.en: this Om has four syllables, four feet, four heads, four measures
meaning.hi: यह ॐ चार अक्षर, चार पैर, चार सिर, चार मात्रा वाला है

words.sanskrit: sthūla-rūpeṇa hrasvaḥ dīrghaḥ pluta eva ca

meaning.en: in its outward shape it is the short, the long, and the most drawn-out sound
meaning.hi: बाहरी रूप में यह ह्रस्व, दीर्घ और सबसे खींचा हुआ स्वर है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: om om om iti trir uktvā

meaning.en: having said Om, Om, Om three times
meaning.hi: ॐ, ॐ, ॐ तीन बार कहकर

meaning.en: what comes fourth is the self at rest
meaning.hi: चौथा शांत आत्मा है

words.sanskrit: pluta-pranave kṛte sakṛt uccārite ātma-jyotiḥ maṇḍalam āgacchati

meaning.en: when the drawn-out pranava is uttered once, the self's light travels a full circle
meaning.hi: खींचा हुआ प्रणव एक बार उच्चारित होने पर आत्मा की ज्योति चक्कर लगाती है

meaning.en: it carries the breath upward, hence it is called the om-sound
meaning.hi: यह प्राण को ऊपर ले जाता है, इसलिए ओंकार कहलाता है

meaning.en: all breaths dissolve into it, hence it is dissolution
meaning.hi: सब प्राण इसी में लीन होते हैं, इसलिए प्रलय

words.sanskrit: sarvān prāṇān param-ātmani praṇāmayati iti praṇavaḥ

meaning.en: it bows all breaths down before the highest self, hence pranava
meaning.hi: यह सब प्राणों को परमात्मा के आगे झुकाता है, इसलिए प्रणव

meaning.en: standing in the fourth, it is the womb of every god and every Veda
meaning.hi: चौथे में स्थित होने से यह हर देवता और वेद का गर्भ है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: let the gods be joined to it
meaning.hi: देवता इसी से जोड़े जाएँ

meaning.en: it carries a person across every sorrow and fear, hence it is the crossing
meaning.hi: यह हर दुख-भय के पार उतारता है, इसलिए तार

meaning.en: all gods enter and settle in it, hence it is Vishnu
meaning.hi: सब देवता इसी में बसते हैं, इसलिए विष्णु

meaning.en: it makes everything swell and grow, hence it is Brahma
meaning.hi: यह सबको बढ़ाता है, इसलिए ब्रह्मा

words.sanskrit: dīpavat sarvam upāsyam sthānam bhāsayati iti bhānuḥ

meaning.en: like a lamp it lights every place to be meditated upon, hence lighting-up
meaning.hi: दीये की तरह यह हर ध्येय स्थान को उजागर करता है, इसलिए प्रकाश

meaning.en: it flashes within the body like lightning, and should be seized like lightning
meaning.hi: यह शरीर में बिजली की तरह कौंधता है, बिजली की तरह पकड़ने योग्य

meaning.en: because it spreads through all worlds, it is the great god
meaning.hi: सब लोकों में व्याप्त होने से यह महादेव है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the first measure is the waking state, being awake
meaning.hi: पहली मात्रा जागृत अवस्था है

meaning.en: the second is the dream state
meaning.hi: दूसरी स्वप्न अवस्था है

meaning.en: the third is dreamless sleep, without content
meaning.hi: तीसरी सुषुप्ति है, विषयरहित

meaning.en: the fourth is turiya
meaning.hi: चौथी तुरीय है

words.sanskrit: mātrā mātrāyām sarva-pādān saṁgṛhya svayaṁ prakāśate

meaning.en: each measure merged in its own state, taking all the feet together, it shines by itself
meaning.hi: हर मात्रा अपनी अवस्था में मिलकर, सब पैरों को थामकर, स्वयं चमकती है

meaning.en: and one comes to be brahman itself
meaning.hi: और ब्रह्म ही हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sarva-karaṇāni ākṛṣyate dhāryam dhriyate caturthī brahma

meaning.en: it draws in every faculty, and whatever must be held is held; brahman is the fourth
meaning.hi: यह हर इंद्रिय खींचता है, जो थामना है वह थमता है; ब्रह्म चौथी मात्रा है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sarva-karaṇāni manasi susthirīkṛtya sā upāsanā viṣṇuḥ

meaning.en: setting every faculty firmly in the mind, that meditation is Vishnu
meaning.hi: हर इंद्रिय को मन में स्थिर करना, वह ध्यान विष्णु है

words.sanskrit: prāṇam sa-karaṇam manasi sthāpayan sa upāsakaḥ rudraḥ

meaning.en: setting the breath with the faculties in the mind, that meditator is Rudra
meaning.hi: प्राण को इंद्रियों सहित मन में बिठाने वाला ध्याता रुद्र है

words.sanskrit: nāda-anta param-ātmani sthāpayet dhyāyet īśānaḥ upāsyaḥ

meaning.en: setting it in the highest self where sound ends, one should meditate: Ishana is to be meditated upon
meaning.hi: नाद के अंत में परमात्मा में बिठाकर ध्यान करे: ईशान ध्येय है

words.sanskrit: sarvam etat brahma viṣṇuḥ rudraḥ indraḥ tataḥ prabhavanti

meaning.en: all this is brahman, Vishnu, Rudra, Indra; all arise from it
meaning.hi: यह सब ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र, इंद्र है; सब इससे उत्पन्न होते हैं

meaning.en: all the senses together with the elements
meaning.hi: सारी इंद्रियाँ भूतों सहित

words.sanskrit: upāsakaḥ na kāraṇa-kāraṇam upāsyaḥ eva kāraṇam sarvaiśvaryam tasya

meaning.en: the meditator is not the cause of causes; the one meditated upon is the cause, and all lordship is his
meaning.hi: ध्याता कारणों का कारण नहीं; ध्येय ही कारण है, सारा ऐश्वर्य उसी का

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: śambhum ākāśa-madhye niścalam dhārayan muhūrtam api

meaning.en: holding Shambhu fast and unmoving in the middle of space, even for a moment
meaning.hi: शंभु को आकाश के बीच में स्थिर थामे, एक क्षण भी

meaning.en: gains the fruit of a hundred sacrifices multiplied seventy-four times
meaning.hi: सौ यज्ञों का फल चौहत्तर गुना पाता है

meaning.en: and the whole path of Om besides
meaning.hi: और ॐ का पूरा मार्ग भी

meaning.en: whatever fruit is in all meditation, discipline, and knowledge, Om or the highest lord knows it
meaning.hi: सब ध्यान, योग और ज्ञान का फल ॐ या परमेश्वर जानते हैं

meaning.en: Shiva alone is to be meditated upon, who does good for a person
meaning.hi: शिव ही ध्येय हैं, जो पुरुष का भला करते हैं

words.sanskrit: sarvam tyaktvā etat atharvaśiraḥ kṛtsnam adhītya

meaning.en: having given up everything and gone through this whole Atharvashikha
meaning.hi: सब त्यागकर इस पूरे अथर्वशिख से गुज़रकर

meaning.en: the twice-born is freed from dwelling in a womb
meaning.hi: द्विज गर्भ-वास से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: Om, that is the truth; thus the Upanishad
meaning.hi: ॐ, यही सत्य है; ऐसी है उपनिषद्

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
